lines: Two voices were resounding down a street of the criminal city.
「Hieeeeeeeeh?!! I knew it, beasts are super-scaryyyyyyyyyyyy!!」
They were Una, fleeing with the case containing the incubi's secret drug in her arms, and the weretiger beastman, pursuing her.
（I told Fuuma-kun 『I'll be fine!』 but I'm not really that fine!）
She thought, while scampering away on the verge of tears.
Her body had been hit by the beastman's roar, and still hadn't fully recovered.
Her legs were unsteady, and she couldn't run at her usual pace.
There was no telling whether she could outrun that terrifying beastman like this.
Una herself was well aware of that, but――
（But!! This is for everyone's sakes! I have to do my best here!）
――Mochizuki Una was a Taimanin who harboured within her the powers of a rabbit.
And rabbits were animals which acted in groups.
She didn't know if that rabbit trait was influencing this, but she loved her friends and comrades, and possessed the courage and resolve to put aside any danger to herself to protect them.
It was for that reason that she had volunteered to serve the dangerous role of bait, like this.
Several minutes of continuing to run away on her own.
Suddenly, there was a restless feeling in Una's lower abdomen.
Was this also an effect of harbouring the powers of a rabbit?
She was extremely susceptible to stress when it came to being alone, and whenever she acted on her own for a long time, she invariably developed a case of overactive bladder.
For that reason, she had even received assessments from the teachers at Gosha to the effect that they “still have concerns with regards to long-term solo missions”.

From the stress of this situation, in which she was fleeing all on her own, separated from everyone else, and being chased by a ferocious wild animal on top of that, Una's bladder felt like it was about to burst any time now――
She ran through the nighttime streets, half-crying.
Pee to the left of her, tiger to the right.
Both of them were critical situations.
（Do I have no choice but to let it out?! If I do that, I can put on a little more speed, too!!）
She even considered releasing her pee while running, as a last resort.
It would be terribly disgraceful behaviour, but nothing could replace a life.
That said, how did that sit with her as a young maiden?
While getting slightly panicked about things like that, Una was continuing to flee, when
A transmission came in on her communicator from her “improvised team” leader, Fuuma Kotarou.
「I'm fine so far, but...... I'm right on the briiiinnnk!!」
『I'm pinpointing your position from my communicator data. Keep running dead straight ahead!!』
『Construction site, two blocks ahead――Run there with all your might!!』
The sounds of swordfighting and shooting on the other end of the communicator.
It seemed that he and the others were in the middle of a fierce battle.
『Sorry, Una!! No time to explain. Just hurry!!!』
『Construction site two blocks ahead! If you get there, you can definitely win!!』
After saying what he had to say, Kotarou simply ended the transmission.
She was completely lost――but right now, all she could do was trust her comrade.
While trembling from the crisis of the beastman and her pee, Una ran through the nighttime streets at full speed.
She arrived at the construction site she had been directed to by Kotarou――
There was nothing that seemed like it would save Una from her predicament.
The construction site was a dead end.
Now that she had gone in here, she also couldn't keep running anymore――
A bestial growl from behind her.
Una timidly looked back, and there was――
The wild animal bared its fangs, and pounced at her.
One strike, then two—She dodged those attacks at the last moment with her natural bursts of energy.
However, it didn't seem like she could keep making last-second dodges like this over and over.
Perhaps because of her rabbit instincts, her body reflexively shrank back in fear.
However, Una also had pride as a Taimanin.
「B-Bring it on, you bastarrrrd!! I'm at least gonna get a punch in before you take me down――」
A lithe white figure leaped in between her and the weretiger.
「――Sorry to keep you waiting, Una. You've done well so far.」
Standing there to protect Una, who had taken a timid combat stance, was the Gosha Academy Headmistress, Taimanin commander-in-chief and strongest Taimanin: Igawa Asagi.
The strength drained from Una's entire body out of wholehearted relief.
『If you get there, you can definitely win!』
Kotarou had said that earlier, and he was absolutely right.
If this person―Igawa Asagi―was here, then everything was going to be okay now.
「Yeah. It looks like I made it just in time.」
Asagi replied to the voice on her communicator.
She was in this underworld city as a supervisor for today's “exam missions”.
Her role was to accompany a different team from Kotarou's, and assist the execution of their mission.
Having remembered that, Kotarou had relayed Una's position to Asagi on his communicator, and indicated that the two of them could meet up at the closest position between them: this construction site.
「Now, what an unruly animal. For you to lay a hand on my student――I suppose a punishment is in order.」
The weretiger growled low, as if wary of the sudden intruder.
With no sign of being intimidated by that, Asagi smiled and readied her ninja sword.
